Procurement

  1. Home
  2. About Us
  3. Funding & Tenders
  4. Procurement

The European Fisheries Control Agency (EFCA) uses a variety of means to select contractors to assist it in carrying out its work programme, in accordance with the public procurement rules of the EU institutions and agencies.

  • Open procedures. EFCA is part of the Funding and Tenders Portal for managing calls for tender. The e-tendering platform facilitates the publication of tender documents and manages questions and answers concerning specifications and procedures detailed on the platform.
  • Low- and middle-value negotiated procedures. EFCA carries out low-value negotiated procedures for contracts valued between EUR 15 000.01 and EUR 60 000 and middle-value negotiated procedures for contracts valued between EUR 60 000.01 and EUR 140 000.

Privacy statement. EFCA’s data-processing activities for procurement procedures and contract management are detailed in its privacy statement.

EFCA procurement plan for 2026 is set out below. Once the tenders are launched, they are announced on the Funding & Tenders Portal (see links in the ‘Open procedures’ and ‘Negotiated procedures’ sections).

1. Open procedures (see applicable procurement thresholds in the introduction above)

Procurement Plan 2026 - Open procedures

2. Low- and middle-value negotiated procedures (see applicable procurement thresholds in the introduction above)

Procurement Plan 2026 - Negotiated procedures

Open procedures with a value exceeding the applicable threshold (see applicable procurement thresholds in the introduction above) are advertised in this section once they have been published on the Funding and Tenders Portal. It is the tenderer’s responsibility to check for updates and modifications on the portal during the tendering period.

The documents will be visible and downloadable, but, in order to use some options on the portal, users will need to log in (see the instructions on how to create a European Commission authentication system (ECAS) account below). Once logged in, users have the option to subscribe to a call for tender. Users will then receive notifications of updates like the publication of new documents. Moreover, subscribing allows users to ask questions related to the call for tender.

NB: All tenders are to be submitted electronically through the Funding & Tenders Portal.

You are requested to create an ECAS account in the system in order to have access to e-submission. See ‘ Help for external users’ for more details.

General guidelines and a helpdesk can be accessed via the Funding & Tenders Portal.

EFCA carries out low-value negotiated procedures for contracts valued between EUR 15 000.01 and EUR 60 000 with at least three candidates.

EFCA carries out middle-value negotiated procedures for contracts valued between EUR 60 000.01 and the applicable threshold (see applicable procurement thresholds in the introduction above) with at least five candidates.

Since June 2023, EFCA has advertised calls for tenders from EUR 15 001 to the threshold above on the Funding & Tenders Portal. Suppliers generally have at least two weeks to express their interest in a specific negotiated procedure.

EFCA will consider all expressions of interest received and will then invite at least three candidates for contracts with a value between EUR 15 000.01 and EUR 60 000 and at least five candidates for contracts with a value between EUR 60 000 and the applicable threshold (see applicable procurement thresholds in the introduction above).

In case there is an upcoming procurement procedure, the interested suppliers must express their interest through the Funding and Tenders Portal.
